documents.title: Reported revised advertisement/publicity delegation — original unverified
documents.notes: Secondary discovery lead only. The identified official original returned 404 on 29 October 2026; date, amounts and applicability remain unverified.

relationships.scope: Corrects the table heading from proposed to revised financial powers; not a new whole-schedule delegation.
The March 2023 CPFC-to-subordinate re-delegation cites the July 2022 CBT-to-CPFC powers. Distinct authority layers; no whole-document supersession inferred.

limitations: Delegation is matter-specific. CBT-to-CPFC powers and CPFC-to-subordinate re-delegations are different authority layers; an infrastructure or claims circular does not replace the entire financial schedule.
The underlying 1993 schedule, several revisions and some originals are missing. References and chronological order alone do not establish supersession or a current monetary ceiling.

Website posting dates and receipt stamps are not substituted for dates printed in the issuing letter. The 2017 name-correction letter is dated 31 October despite its 1 November receipt stamp; the PID re-delegation is dated 9 March 2023.
The May 2016 general-delegation letter is a consultation, not an operative revision. It is visible in the inventory but excluded from answer evidence.
The reported 7 August 2026 advertisement/publicity revision remains original-unverified and cannot establish revised ceilings. Medical delegation originals also remain unresolved.

Claim settlement authority (including inoperative accounts and multi-location/CRO and SSO arrangements), PF member name-correction powers and foreign-visit permissions are in their own collections. This collection is the administrative and financial powers schedule and its revisions.

The 16 August 2010 circular restates the revised financial powers (Annexures I-III); amounts are in the annexures. The 11 June 2019 draft on Rule 18 (CCS Conduct) is a consultation, not an operative delegation.

PDFs for entries marked compiled_copy were read from a compilation of circulars (Delegation_Circulars_Combined.pdf); its hash identifies the compilation, not a public original, and the app does not offer a download for them. Scanned pages are OCR.

Dates follow the letter, not the website listing. Three circulars differ from the issuer listing: the revised financial powers (letter 20 July 2010, listed 16 August 2010), a 2009 medical-expenses letter (typed 13 August, listed 17 August) and the 2013 revised financial powers (typed 17 January, listed 21 January). The entries carry a date_note.

The February 2022 draft compendium on the schedule of delegation is a consultation circulated for suggestions; it is visible in the inventory but is not operative evidence, and only its covering pages are extracted (the draft runs to 130 pages).
